name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; accurately describes the bottom narrow strip (0x3F=63 bytes wide, 0xF=15 rows) slide-step, parallel to sibling fd2_slide_panel_step_bottom_main (the wide bottom panel). No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Render one frame of the Party Status Overview screen's bottom narrow strip sliding up from below into its settled position at y=0xAC.
logic_summary: row_count starts 0xF. Frames < 8 return early (other panels still entering; this strip is the last). For frame >= 0xD the strip is settled at dst_y = 0xAC. For frames 8..0xC, y_shift = (4 - (frame-8))*4 (frame 8=16,9=12,0xA=8,0xB=4,0xC=0) and dst_y = y_shift + 0xAC, descending toward 0xAC by 4 rows/frame; if dst_y+0xF > 200 (bottom-edge overrun) row_count = dst_y - 200 (frame 8 -> dst_y=188 -> row_count=-12, so nothing drawn that frame). Source row 0 = src_buffer + 0xD781; dst row 0 offset = dst_y*0x140 + 0x81. Loop row 0..row_count: memmove(data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr + dst_off, src_row_ptr, 0x3F); both pointers advance by 0x140 (320, screen stride) per row.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Source panel content buffer base (the malloc'd 64000-byte panel_buf populated by fd2_render_party_status_overview_content). Row 0 of the bottom narrow strip is read from src_buffer + 0xD781.
params.reason: Ghidra live name param_1 is a generic placeholder that does not reflect purpose; src declaration already uses src_buffer (matches sibling slide-step functions). Stage 2 should rename the Ghidra param to src_buffer.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Slide animation frame index, 0..0xB. Caller drives it 0->0xB (intro slide-in) and 0xB->0 (outro slide-out). Selects skip (<8) / sliding (8..0xC) / settled (>=0xD).
params.reason: Ghidra live name param_2 is a generic placeholder; src declaration already uses frame_idx (matches sibling slide-step functions). Stage 2 should rename the Ghidra param to frame_idx.

returns.semantics: No return value; writes directly into the data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr workspace.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was a single terse one-liner ('Bottom narrow strip slide-in from below (0x3F-wide, 0xF rows).') lacking the frame-range / clipping / settled-position / caller documentation present on the sibling slide-step functions (bottom_main, top_small).
notes: src signature already uses good param names (src_buffer, frame_idx); rename verdicts apply to the Ghidra live params (param_1/param_2) for Stage 2. Plate is detailed, accurate, and semantically consistent with the refined src comment, so left untouched. The reads/writes of data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr are via base+offset; the actual pixel source is the src_buffer parameter (not a global). __CHK(0x20,...) prologue is the compiler-injected stack probe, not source logic. Caller (sole): fd2_open_party_status_overview_screen @ 0x1b1e7, 2 call sites (intro 0x1b2c8, outro 0x1b3c9).
